description:
The Talon community command set is installed at C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community. A text editor has the file C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\TalonTasks\my_commands.talon open. This file currently only contains a context header. Your task is to add three custom voice commands to this .talon file:

1. A command 'open downloads' that presses the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+J (commonly opens the downloads panel in browsers). The syntax is: open downloads: key(ctrl-j)
2. A command 'say hello world' that types the text 'Hello, World!' using the insert() action. The syntax is: say hello world: insert("Hello, World!")
3. A command 'clear line' that selects the current line and deletes it. This is a multi-line command:
   clear line:
       edit.select_line()
       edit.delete()

After adding these three commands, save the file using Ctrl+S.
